development.usageZh: 不可数名词。常与介词 'of' 连用，表示某事物的发展。例如：the development of technology。 Uncountable noun. Often used with the preposition 'of' to indicate the development of something. E.g., the development of technology.

examples.sentence: The development of her drawing surprised the class.
examples.trans: 她绘画的发展让全班吃惊。

examples.sentence: Phone development made maps easier to carry.
examples.trans: 手机的发展让地图更容易随身带。

examples.sentence: Healthy development needs sleep, food, and a kind adult.
examples.trans: 健康的发展需要睡眠、食物和一位友善的大人。

examples.sentence: Urban development without buses is just taller isolation.
examples.trans: 没有公交的城市发展只是更高的孤立。

examples.sentence: The development of a platform is not the same as the development of a public.
examples.trans: 平台的发展并不等于公众的发展。

examples.sentence: When development is measured only in speed, the people who cannot keep up become a rounding error.
examples.trans: 当发展只用速度衡量，跟不上的人就会变成四舍五入的误差。

convenient.usageZh: 形容词。常用结构：It is convenient (for sb) to do sth。反义词是 inconvenient。 Adjective. Common structure: It is convenient (for sb) to do sth. Antonym is inconvenient.

examples.sentence: The shop near school is convenient for bread.
examples.trans: 学校附近的店买面包很方便。

examples.sentence: A convenient app still needs a password you can remember.
examples.trans: 方便的应用仍需要一个你记得住的密码。

examples.sentence: The most convenient choice is not always the fairest one.
examples.trans: 最方便的选择并不总是最公平的。

examples.sentence: Convenient checkout can hide a fee in the last second.
examples.trans: 方便的结账可能在最后一秒藏一笔费用。

examples.sentence: What is convenient for a company may be exhausting for a night-shift worker.
examples.trans: 对公司方便的，对夜班工人可能是耗尽。

examples.sentence: A convenient silence in the terms of service is still a political design.
examples.trans: 服务条款里方便的沉默仍是一种政治设计。

purchase.usageZh: 既可作动词，也可作名词。作动词时是及物动词，直接接宾语。作名词时常用搭配：make a purchase。 Can be both a verb and a noun. As a verb, it is transitive. As a noun, common collocation: make a purchase.

examples.sentence: I will purchase a notebook after school.
examples.trans: 放学后我将买一本笔记本。

examples.sentence: Please purchase water before the long bus ride.
examples.trans: 长途公交前请买好水。

examples.sentence: Check the size before you purchase the shoes online.
examples.trans: 网上买鞋前先核对尺码。

examples.sentence: A purchase that cannot be refunded needs a slower decision.
examples.trans: 无法退款的购买需要更慢的决定。

examples.sentence: In-app purchase buttons are designed to arrive before second thoughts.
examples.trans: 应用内购买按钮被设计成赶在第二想法之前到达。

examples.sentence: A public purchase without an open tender is a gift with a receipt.
examples.trans: 没有公开招标的公共采购是一张带收据的礼物。

application.usageZh: 可数名词。在科技语境下常缩写为 'app'，指手机应用程序。申请的意思常用搭配：an application for (a job/school)。 Countable noun. In tech contexts, often abbreviated as 'app', referring to mobile applications. For the 'request' meaning, common collocation: an application for (a job/school).

examples.sentence: This application helps us learn new words.
examples.trans: 这个应用程序帮我们学新词。

examples.sentence: Her application for the art club was a short letter.
examples.trans: 她申请美术社的材料是一封短信。

examples.sentence: Read the application rules before you press send.
examples.trans: 按发送前先读申请规则。

examples.sentence: An application that asks for extra permissions is not a toy.
examples.trans: 索要额外权限的应用程序不是玩具。

examples.sentence: A job application that cannot name a weakness is already performing.
examples.trans: 叫不出弱点的求职申请已经在表演。

examples.sentence: When every civic task becomes an application, people without phones become unofficial.
examples.trans: 当每项公民事务都变成应用程序，没有手机的人就变成非正式的。

register.usageZh: 及物或不及物动词。常用搭配：register for a course (注册课程)，register on a website (在网站注册)。

examples.sentence: Please register for the school trip before Friday.
examples.trans: 请在周五前注册学校旅行。

examples.sentence: She will register on the library website tonight.
examples.trans: 她今晚将在图书馆网站注册。

examples.sentence: You must register with a real email, not a joke one.
examples.trans: 你必须用真实邮箱注册，而不是玩笑邮箱。

examples.sentence: Voters register because a right unused is a right at risk.
examples.trans: 选民去登记，因为不用的权利是有风险的权利。

examples.sentence: To register a complaint and receive only a ticket number is not to be heard.
examples.trans: 登记投诉却只收到票号，并不等于被听见。

examples.sentence: Platforms that make it easy to register and hard to leave have chosen a trap, not a service.
examples.trans: 让注册容易、离开困难的平台，选的是陷阱而不是服务。

deliver.usageZh: 及物动词。常用结构：deliver sth to sb/somewhere。名词形式是 delivery。 Transitive verb. Common structure: deliver sth to sb/somewhere. Noun form is delivery.

examples.sentence: The shop will deliver the cake before three.
examples.trans: 商店会在三点前把蛋糕送到。

examples.sentence: Can you deliver this note to the office?
examples.trans: 你能把这张纸条送到办公室吗？

examples.sentence: Trucks deliver food even when the rain is heavy.
examples.trans: 即使雨很大，卡车仍会运送食物。

examples.sentence: A promise is cheap until you deliver the timetable.
examples.trans: 在你交付时间表之前，承诺都很便宜。

examples.sentence: Couriers who deliver in heatwaves are not a feature; they are a workforce.
examples.trans: 在热浪中送货的快递员不是功能，是劳动力。

examples.sentence: Governments that deliver speeches instead of water have already chosen an audience over a public.
examples.trans: 只交付演讲而不交付水的政府，已经选择了观众而不是公众。

refund.usageZh: 可作名词和动词。名词常用搭配：get a refund。动词常用结构：refund (sb) sth 或 refund sth to sb。 Can be a noun and a verb. Noun common collocation: get a refund. Verb common structure: refund (sb) sth or refund sth to sb.

examples.sentence: If the book is damaged, you can get a refund.
examples.trans: 如果书损坏了，你可以退款。

examples.sentence: She asked for a refund when the shoes were the wrong size.
examples.trans: 鞋码不对时，她要求退款。

examples.sentence: Keep the receipt if you might need a refund later.
examples.trans: 以后可能要退款的话，请保留收据。

examples.sentence: A refund that takes thirty days is a loan you did not agree to.
examples.trans: 需要三十天的退款是一笔你没同意的贷款。

examples.sentence: Companies hide the refund button because delay is profitable.
examples.trans: 公司藏起退款按钮，因为拖延有利可图。

examples.sentence: A public refund of trust is harder than a public refund of money, and rarer.
examples.trans: 信任的公开退款比金钱的公开退款更难，也更罕见。

insurance.usageZh: 不可数名词。常用搭配：have/buy/take out insurance (on/for sth)。 Uncountable noun. Common collocation: have/buy/take out insurance (on/for sth).

examples.sentence: Travel insurance can help if a bag is lost.
examples.trans: 如果行李丢失，旅行保险能帮忙。

examples.sentence: Read the insurance paper before you tick the box.
examples.trans: 打钩之前先读保险文件。

examples.sentence: Bike insurance does not replace a lock and a light.
examples.trans: 自行车保险替代不了锁和灯。

examples.sentence: Health insurance that excludes the likely illness is a story, not a shield.
examples.trans: 把很可能的病排除在外的健康保险是故事，不是盾。

examples.sentence: Insurance fine print is where the rain actually starts.
examples.trans: 保险小字才是雨真正开始的地方。

examples.sentence: A society that treats insurance as a personality test has already decided who may fall.
examples.trans: 把保险当性格测验的社会，已经决定了谁可以摔倒。

reservation.usageZh: 可数名词。常用搭配：make a reservation (for sth)。动词是 reserve。 Countable noun. Common collocation: make a reservation (for sth). Verb is reserve.

examples.sentence: We made a reservation for dinner at six.
examples.trans: 我们订了六点的晚餐。

examples.sentence: Please make a reservation if more than four people are coming.
examples.trans: 如果超过四个人来，请先预订。

examples.sentence: The hotel lost our reservation, so we showed the email.
examples.trans: 酒店弄丢了我们的预订，所以我们出示了邮件。

examples.sentence: A reservation system that needs three apps is a barrier dressed as service.
examples.trans: 需要三个应用的预订系统是打扮成服务的障碍。

examples.sentence: Hospitals that require a reservation for urgent care have redefined urgency.
examples.trans: 要求紧急护理先预订的医院，已经重新定义了紧急。

examples.sentence: When every public desk needs a reservation, the street becomes unofficial life.
examples.trans: 当每张公共桌子都需要预订，街道就变成非正式生活。

appointment.usageZh: 可数名词。常用搭配：make/have an appointment (with sb) (for sth)。动词是 appoint。 Countable noun. Common collocation: make/have an appointment (with sb) (for sth). Verb is appoint.

examples.sentence: I have a dentist appointment after school.
examples.trans: 放学后我有牙医预约。

examples.sentence: Please make an appointment if you want extra help.
examples.trans: 如果你想要额外帮助，请预约。

examples.sentence: She arrived early for the appointment and sat with a book.
examples.trans: 她预约来早了，坐着看书。

examples.sentence: Missing an appointment can still be a bus problem, not a character problem.
examples.trans: 错过预约仍可能是公交问题，不是性格问题。

examples.sentence: An appointment two months away is a quiet way of saying no.
examples.trans: 两个月以后的预约是一种安静的拒绝。

examples.sentence: A right that exists only by appointment is a permission, not a right.
examples.trans: 只靠预约存在的权利是许可，不是权利。

accommodation.usageZh: 不可数名词（英式英语）。指住宿的地方，常用搭配：arrange/find accommodation。 Uncountable noun (British English). Refers to a place to stay. Common collocation: arrange/find accommodation.

examples.sentence: Our accommodation was a small room near the station.
examples.trans: 我们的住宿是车站附近的小房间。

examples.sentence: The school helps families find accommodation for the sports trip.
examples.trans: 学校帮家庭找运动会旅行的住宿。

examples.sentence: Cheap accommodation can still be clean if someone cares.
examples.trans: 如果有人在意，便宜的住宿仍然可以干净。

examples.sentence: Student accommodation that is a two-hour commute is a hidden fee.
examples.trans: 通勤两小时的学生住宿是一笔隐藏费用。

examples.sentence: Emergency accommodation in a gym is not a housing policy.
examples.trans: 体育馆里的紧急住宿不是住房政策。

examples.sentence: A city that calls any roof accommodation has given up on the idea of a home.
examples.trans: 把任何屋顶都称为住宿的城市，已经放弃了家的概念。

reliable.usageZh: 形容词。常用结构：be reliable。名词是 reliability。 Adjective. Common structure: be reliable. Noun is reliability.

examples.sentence: A reliable clock helps you catch the bus.
examples.trans: 可靠的钟能帮你赶上公交。

examples.sentence: She is a reliable partner in group work.
examples.trans: 她在小组作业里是可靠的搭档。

examples.sentence: A reliable map is better than a pretty one that lies.
examples.trans: 可靠的地图比会撒谎的漂亮地图更好。

examples.sentence: A reliable source names a date; an exciting one names a feeling.
examples.trans: 可靠的来源点出日期；刺激的来源点出感觉。

examples.sentence: The most reliable number is the one a second person can find again.
examples.trans: 最可靠的数字是第二个人还能再找到的那个。

examples.sentence: Infrastructure is reliable only if it works for the person without a spare hour.
examples.trans: 基础设施只有对没有多余一小时的人也有效时，才算可靠。

benefit.usageZh: 可作名词和动词。名词常用搭配：benefit of/from sth。动词常用结构：benefit from sth。 Can be a noun and a verb. Noun common collocation: benefit of/from sth. Verb common structure: benefit from sth.

examples.sentence: A short walk can benefit your mood after class.
examples.trans: 课后短走能让你的心情受益。

examples.sentence: What is the benefit of packing the bag at night?
examples.trans: 晚上收拾书包的好处是什么？

examples.sentence: Sharing notes can benefit the whole group if everyone contributes.
examples.trans: 如果人人都贡献，分享笔记能让全组受益。

examples.sentence: A policy must name who will not benefit, not only who will smile.
examples.trans: 政策必须点出谁不会受益，而不只是谁会微笑。

examples.sentence: The benefit of speed disappears when the refund never arrives.
examples.trans: 退款永远不到时，速度的好处就消失了。

examples.sentence: If the public cannot see the benefit in a budget line, the slogan is doing the work.
examples.trans: 如果公众在预算科目里看不见好处，就是口号在干活。

arrange.usageZh: 动词。常用结构：arrange sth (for sb)；arrange to do sth；arrange for sb to do sth。名词是 arrangement。 Verb. Common structures: arrange sth (for sb); arrange to do sth; arrange for sb to do sth. Noun is arrangement.

examples.sentence: Please arrange the chairs in a circle.
examples.trans: 请把椅子排成一圈。

examples.sentence: We will arrange a time to practise the song.
examples.trans: 我们会安排时间练习这首歌。

examples.sentence: Can you arrange the books from thin to thick?
examples.trans: 你能把书从薄到厚排列吗？

examples.sentence: The office will arrange an interpreter if you ask early.
examples.trans: 如果你早点问，办公室会安排翻译。

examples.sentence: To arrange a hearing after the decision is to arrange theatre.
examples.trans: 在决定之后再安排听证，就是在安排演戏。

examples.sentence: A state that can arrange a parade in a week but cannot arrange a bus has chosen its art form.
examples.trans: 一周能安排游行却安排不了公交的国家，已经选好了它的艺术形式。

official.usageZh: 形容词和名词。作形容词常用在名词前，如 official website。作名词指官员。 Adjective and noun. As an adjective, often used before a noun, e.g., official website. As a noun, it refers to an officer.

examples.sentence: The official website lists the real exam date.
examples.trans: 官方网站列出真正的考试日期。

examples.sentence: Wait for the official notice before you pack.
examples.trans: 打包前等官方通知。

examples.sentence: An official stamp does not make a rumour true.
examples.trans: 官方印章并不能让谣言变真。

examples.sentence: The official story left out who paid for the trip.
examples.trans: 官方说法漏掉了谁为旅行付钱。

examples.sentence: Official silence after a leak is still a statement.
examples.trans: 泄露之后的官方沉默仍是一种表态。

examples.sentence: When official language cannot name a cost, unofficial language will, and it will be angrier.
examples.trans: 当官方语言叫不出代价，非官方语言会叫出来，而且会更愤怒。

avoid.usageZh: 及物动词。后面接名词或动名词 (avoid doing sth)。 Transitive verb. Followed by a noun or a gerund (avoid doing sth).

examples.sentence: Avoid running in the wet corridor.
examples.trans: 避免在潮湿的走廊里奔跑。

examples.sentence: Please avoid food with nuts; someone is allergic.
examples.trans: 请避免带坚果的食物；有人过敏。

examples.sentence: You cannot avoid every mistake, but you can avoid hiding it.
examples.trans: 你无法避免每一个错误，但可以避免藏起来。

examples.sentence: Avoid sharing medical photos in a group chat.
examples.trans: 避免在群聊里分享医疗照片。

examples.sentence: Companies avoid the word 'injury' and prefer 'incident'.
examples.trans: 公司避免“工伤”这个词，更喜欢“事件”。

examples.sentence: A press strategy whose only skill is to avoid the record will eventually become the record.
examples.trans: 唯一技能是避开记录的新闻策略，最终会自己变成记录。

experience.usageZh: 可作名词和动词。作名词时，表示'经验'不可数，表示'经历'可数。作动词是及物动词。 Can be a noun and a verb. As a noun, 'experience' (knowledge) is uncountable, 'an experience' (event) is countable. As a verb, it is transitive.

examples.sentence: Camping was a new experience for him.
examples.trans: 露营对他来说是新体验。

examples.sentence: She has experience looking after younger cousins.
examples.trans: 她有照顾表弟表妹的经验。

examples.sentence: A hard experience can still teach a useful skill.
examples.trans: 艰难的经历仍可以教给你有用的技能。

examples.sentence: Unpaid experience is often just unpaid work with a nicer name.
examples.trans: 无薪经历常常只是名字更好听的无薪工作。

examples.sentence: User experience that hides the cancel button is a business model.
examples.trans: 藏起取消按钮的用户体验是一种商业模式。

examples.sentence: Lived experience is evidence; it is not a licence to skip other evidence.
examples.trans: 亲身经历是证据；它不是跳过其他证据的许可证。

various.usageZh: 形容词。只用在名词前作定语。名词形式是 variety。 Adjective. Only used before a noun as an attributive. Noun form is variety.

examples.sentence: The stall sells various fruits in summer.
examples.trans: 这个摊位夏天卖各种各样的水果。

examples.sentence: We tried various ways to open the stuck window.
examples.trans: 我们试了各种各样的方法去开卡住的窗。

examples.sentence: Various clubs meet on Friday, so check the notice.
examples.trans: 各种各样的社团周五碰面，所以看通知。

examples.sentence: Various explanations can be true at once; that is not an excuse to pick the kindest.
examples.trans: 各种各样的解释可以同时为真；那不是挑选最温和那个的借口。

examples.sentence: The report lists various stakeholders and then quotes only two.
examples.trans: 报告列出各种各样的利益相关者，然后只引用两个。

examples.sentence: Various platforms, one owner, is not diversity; it is a costume.
examples.trans: 各种各样的平台、同一个主人，不是多样性，是戏服。

attention.usageZh: 不可数名词。常用短语：gain/attract/draw attention (引起关注)，pay attention to (注意)。

examples.sentence: Please pay attention to the wet floor sign.
examples.trans: 请注意小心地滑的标志。

examples.sentence: The magic trick stole our attention for a minute.
examples.trans: 魔术把我们的注意力偷走了一分钟。

examples.sentence: Too much attention on one student can make others invisible.
examples.trans: 对一个学生的过多关注会让别人看不见。

examples.sentence: The video gained attention, then lost the facts in the comments.
examples.trans: 视频获得了关注，然后在评论里丢掉了事实。

examples.sentence: Attention is a market, and outrage is often the cheapest product.
examples.trans: 注意力是市场，愤怒常常是最便宜的产品。

examples.sentence: A politics of attention will always outrun a politics of maintenance.
examples.trans: 注意力政治永远会跑赢维护政治。

edit.usageZh: 及物动词。常用搭配：edit a video/document (剪辑视频/编辑文档)。

examples.sentence: Please edit the extra comma in your sentence.
examples.trans: 请编辑句子里多余的逗号。

examples.sentence: We will edit the video so it is two minutes long.
examples.trans: 我们会把视频剪到两分钟。

examples.sentence: Edit the message before you send it to the whole class.
examples.trans: 发给全班前先编辑这条消息。

examples.sentence: To edit a quote is sometimes to rescue it, and sometimes to kidnap it.
examples.trans: 编辑引语有时是拯救它，有时是绑架它。

examples.sentence: Platforms that edit ranking in secret are editing public life.
examples.trans: 秘密编辑排序的平台，是在编辑公共生活。

examples.sentence: A history you cannot edit is a duty; a history you can edit without a log is a toy.
examples.trans: 不能编辑的历史是责任；能不留日志就编辑的历史是玩具。

attractive.usageZh: 形容词。常用结构：be attractive to sb. (对某人有吸引力)。

examples.sentence: The attractive poster used only three colours.
examples.trans: 那张有吸引力的海报只用了三种颜色。

examples.sentence: An attractive cover does not prove the book is kind.
examples.trans: 有吸引力的封面不能证明书是友善的。

examples.sentence: The park is attractive in autumn because the leaves are loud.
examples.trans: 秋天公园很有吸引力，因为叶子很喧闹。

examples.sentence: An attractive offer that expires tonight is a design, not luck.
examples.trans: 今晚到期的有吸引力的优惠是设计，不是运气。

examples.sentence: Attractive data visualisations can still sit on ugly methods.
examples.trans: 有吸引力的数据可视化仍可能坐落在丑陋的方法上。

examples.sentence: Making a cut look attractive is how a budget becomes a lifestyle brand.
examples.trans: 让削减看起来有吸引力，就是预算变成生活方式品牌的方式。

platform.usageZh: 可数名词。常用搭配：social media platform (社交媒体平台)，online learning platform (在线学习平台)。

examples.sentence: Wait on the platform behind the yellow line.
examples.trans: 在站台黄线后面等。

examples.sentence: This learning platform has a quiet night mode.
examples.trans: 这个学习平台有安静的夜间模式。

examples.sentence: A jump platform at the pool has a height mark for a reason.
examples.trans: 泳池跳台标着高度是有原因的。

examples.sentence: A platform that ranks anger first is not a town square.
examples.trans: 把愤怒排在第一位的平台不是市政广场。

examples.sentence: The same platform sells both the news and the ads that shout over it.
examples.trans: 同一个平台既卖新闻，也卖盖过新闻的广告。

examples.sentence: Calling a corporation a platform is a way of shrinking its duties to a floor plan.
examples.trans: 把公司称为平台，是把它的责任缩小成平面图。

occupation.usageZh: 可数名词。常用短语：choose an occupation (选择职业)，a full-time occupation (全职工作)。

examples.sentence: Her dream occupation is to be a gardener.
examples.trans: 她梦想的职业是园丁。

examples.sentence: The form asks for a parent's occupation.
examples.trans: 表格询问家长的职业。

examples.sentence: An occupation you hate will still fill the hours; choose with care.
examples.trans: 你讨厌的职业仍会填满那些小时；请小心选择。

examples.sentence: Gig work is an occupation even when an app refuses the word 'job'.
examples.trans: 零工仍是一种职业，即使应用拒绝“工作”这个词。

examples.sentence: Occupation prestige is a poor guide to who keeps the city alive at 4 a.m.
examples.trans: 职业声望是很差的指南，说明不了谁在凌晨四点维持城市。

examples.sentence: When occupation becomes identity, unemployment becomes a moral sentence.
examples.trans: 当职业变成身份，失业就变成道德判决。

renowned.usageZh: 形容词。通常作定语，修饰名词。常用搭配：a renowned artist/university (著名的艺术家/大学)。

examples.sentence: A renowned chef visited our cooking club.
examples.trans: 一位著名厨师来访我们的烹饪社。

examples.sentence: The town is renowned for its quiet river.
examples.trans: 这个镇子因安静的河而著名。

examples.sentence: A renowned school can still have an unkind timetable.
examples.trans: 著名学校仍可能有不友善的时间表。

examples.sentence: Renowned teachers still need a contract that lets them sleep.
examples.trans: 名师仍需要一份让他们能睡觉的合同。

examples.sentence: A renowned brand can fund a lab and still bury an inconvenient paper.
examples.trans: 著名品牌可以资助实验室，却仍埋葬一篇不便的论文。

examples.sentence: Renown without a record is celebrity; renowned cruelty is still cruelty.
examples.trans: 没有记录的名声是名流；著名的残忍仍是残忍。

fragmented.usageZh: 形容词。常用搭配：fragmented time (碎片时间)，fragmented information (碎片化信息)。

examples.sentence: Her notes were fragmented after the bus shook.
examples.trans: 公交晃动后，她的笔记变得零碎。

examples.sentence: Fragmented sleep made the morning feel longer.
examples.trans: 碎片化的睡眠让早晨显得更长。

examples.sentence: A fragmented story is harder to retell fairly.
examples.trans: 碎片化的故事更难被公正地复述。

examples.sentence: Fragmented attention is a product, not an accident of youth.
examples.trans: 碎片化注意力是一种产品，不是青春的意外。

examples.sentence: A fragmented archive will always favour the side that kept the binders.
examples.trans: 碎片化的档案永远偏袒保存了活页夹的那一方。

examples.sentence: Fragmented media can still be owned by one desk; scatter is not independence.
examples.trans: 碎片化媒体仍可能被一张桌子拥有；分散不是独立。

review.usageZh: 及物动词或名词。常用搭配：review the lessons (复习功课)，a book review (书评)。

examples.sentence: Let's review the new words before the quiz.
examples.trans: 测验前我们复习新词吧。

examples.sentence: Please review your answers if you finish early.
examples.trans: 如果提前做完，请复查答案。

examples.sentence: A kind review of a friend's story still names a weak line.
examples.trans: 对朋友故事的友善评论仍会点出一句弱的。

examples.sentence: A peer review that cannot reject a paper is a ceremony.
examples.trans: 不能拒稿的同行评议是仪式。

examples.sentence: App reviews written in the first hour are ads with spelling.
examples.trans: 第一小时写下的应用评论是带拼写的广告。

examples.sentence: A review of the year that forgets the night shift is a brochure for daylight.
examples.trans: 忘掉夜班的年度回顾是给白昼的宣传册。

download.usageZh: 及物动词。反义词：upload (上传)。常用搭配：download a file/app (下载文件/应用)。

examples.sentence: You can download the worksheet from the class site.
examples.trans: 你可以从班级网站下载练习纸。

examples.sentence: Don't download a game that asks for your photos.
examples.trans: 不要下载索要你照片的游戏。

examples.sentence: We will download the map before the mountain trip.
examples.trans: 上山前我们会下载地图。

examples.sentence: A free download can still sell your location in the background.
examples.trans: 免费下载仍可能在后台卖掉你的位置。

examples.sentence: Students cannot download a lab; they still need a bench.
examples.trans: 学生下载不了一个实验室；他们仍需要一张实验台。

examples.sentence: Culture you can only download is culture you do not yet own.
examples.trans: 你只能下载的文化，是你尚未拥有的文化。

instructor.usageZh: 可数名词。常用搭配：a driving instructor (驾驶教练)，a fitness instructor (健身教练)。

examples.sentence: The swimming instructor asked us to kick slowly.
examples.trans: 游泳教练让我们慢慢踢水。

examples.sentence: A patient instructor waits while you try the knot again.
examples.trans: 有耐心的指导者会等你再试一次打结。

examples.sentence: Our driving instructor repeats the mirror check every time.
examples.trans: 我们的驾驶教练每次都重复看后视镜。

examples.sentence: An online instructor is still a worker, not a feature of the platform.
examples.trans: 线上指导者仍是劳动者，不是平台的功能。

examples.sentence: A famous instructor with no time for questions is a poster.
examples.trans: 没时间回答问题的著名指导者是海报。

examples.sentence: When the instructor is a video that cannot hear you, the failure is yours on paper only.
examples.trans: 当指导者是听不见你的视频，失败在纸面上只属于你。

negative.usageZh: 形容词。反义词：positive (积极的)。常用搭配：negative views/effects (负面观点/影响)。

examples.sentence: A negative comment can still be useful if it is kind.
examples.trans: 负面评论如果友善，仍然可以有用。

examples.sentence: Don't stay in a negative mood all evening after one mistake.
examples.trans: 不要因为一个错误整晚都停留在消极心情里。

examples.sentence: She turned a negative result into a new experiment.
examples.trans: 她把一个负面结果变成了新实验。

examples.sentence: Negative evidence is still evidence; do not hide it in an appendix.
examples.trans: 负面证据仍是证据；不要把它藏进附录。

examples.sentence: A negative review that names a fact is more civic than a cheerful lie.
examples.trans: 点出事实的差评比愉快的谎言更有公共性。

examples.sentence: Banning negative speech about a policy is how the policy becomes a faith.
examples.trans: 禁止对政策的负面言论，就是让政策变成信仰。

mislead.usageZh: 及物动词。过去式和过去分词：misled。常用结构：mislead sb. into doing sth. (误导某人做某事)。

examples.sentence: A wrong arrow can mislead visitors to the gym.
examples.trans: 错误的箭头会把访客误导到体育馆。

examples.sentence: Don't mislead your parents about the homework page.
examples.trans: 不要在作业页码上误导父母。

examples.sentence: A joke should not mislead someone about a real danger.
examples.trans: 笑话不该在真正的危险上误导人。

examples.sentence: Labels that mislead about sugar are a design, not a slip.
examples.trans: 在糖分上误导的标签是设计，不是口误。

examples.sentence: Thumbnails that mislead are the business model, not a side effect.
examples.trans: 误导性缩略图是商业模式，不是副作用。

examples.sentence: To mislead a public and then blame its 'confusion' is a completed trick.
examples.trans: 误导公众然后再责怪其“困惑”，是一套完成的戏法。

blogger.usageZh: 可数名词。由 blog (博客) 加后缀 -er 构成。相关词：vlogger (视频博主)。

examples.sentence: The food blogger took a photo before she ate.
examples.trans: 美食博主在吃之前拍了照。

examples.sentence: A travel blogger visited our town and drew the bridge.
examples.trans: 一位旅行博主来到我们镇，画了那座桥。

examples.sentence: Not every blogger is paid, but every blogger still has a point of view.
examples.trans: 不是每位博主都有报酬，但每位博主仍有观点。

examples.sentence: A blogger with undisclosed gifts is an advertiser with a diary.
examples.trans: 不披露赠品的博主是带着日记的广告商。

examples.sentence: The platform needs the blogger more than the blogger needs a labour law, apparently.
examples.trans: 显然，平台需要博主，胜过博主需要劳动法。

examples.sentence: When a blogger's audience is sold as a crowd, the person becomes inventory.
examples.trans: 当博主的观众被当作人群卖掉，这个人就变成库存。

economy.usageZh: 可数或不可数名词。常用搭配：global economy (全球经济)，knowledge economy (知识经济)。

examples.sentence: Our town's economy depends on the weekend market.
examples.trans: 我们镇的经济依靠周末集市。

examples.sentence: A broken bridge hurts the local economy for months.
examples.trans: 断桥会伤害本地经济好几个月。

examples.sentence: The school play also supports the economy of the costume shop.
examples.trans: 学校话剧也支撑着服装店的经济。

examples.sentence: A gig economy that cannot fund sick days is an old economy with an app.
examples.trans: 无法支付病假的零工经济是带应用的旧经济。

examples.sentence: Attention economy is still an economy: someone is paid, someone is used.
examples.trans: 注意力经济仍是经济：有人被付钱，有人被使用。

examples.sentence: An economy that counts growth and not the night shift has chosen which lives are data.
examples.trans: 只计算增长、不算夜班的经济，已经选好了哪些生命是数据。

display.usageZh: 及物动词或名词。常用搭配：display goods (陈列商品)，on display (在展览中)。

examples.sentence: Please display your badge at the door.
examples.trans: 请在门口出示你的徽章。

examples.sentence: The museum will display the old maps this month.
examples.trans: 博物馆本月将展出那些旧地图。

examples.sentence: A shop window can display fruit and still hide the prices.
examples.trans: 橱窗可以展示水果，却仍藏起价格。

examples.sentence: To display a number without a method is to display a costume.
examples.trans: 展示没有方法的数字，就是展示戏服。

examples.sentence: Airports display delay times and still sell the fiction of control.
examples.trans: 机场展示延误时间，却仍在卖控制的虚构。

examples.sentence: A state that can display a parade but cannot display a wait-time has chosen spectacle.
examples.trans: 能展示游行却不能展示等候时间的国家，已经选择了奇观。

profit.usageZh: 可数或不可数名词。常用短语：make a profit (盈利)，non-profit organization (非营利组织)。

examples.sentence: The bake sale made a small profit for the library.
examples.trans: 烘焙义卖为图书馆赚了一点利润。

examples.sentence: They used the profit to buy new footballs.
examples.trans: 他们用利润买了新足球。

examples.sentence: A fair shop still needs a profit, but not a cruel one.
examples.trans: 公平的店仍需要利润，但不是残酷的利润。

examples.sentence: Profit that depends on unpaid overtime is a stolen hour.
examples.trans: 依赖无薪加班的利润是被偷走的一小时。

examples.sentence: A platform's profit graph and its safety graph rarely share a slide.
examples.trans: 平台的利润图和安全图很少出现在同一张幻灯片上。

examples.sentence: If the public good is a side effect of profit, it will be cut when the quarter is ugly.
examples.trans: 如果公益只是利润的副作用，季度难看时它就会被砍掉。

broadcast.usageZh: 动词 (过去式/过去分词：broadcast) 或名词。常用搭配：live broadcast (直播)，broadcast news (播报新闻)。

examples.sentence: The school will broadcast the match on the hall screen.
examples.trans: 学校将在大厅屏幕上播送比赛。

examples.sentence: They broadcast the weather twice an hour in storm season.
examples.trans: 风暴季节他们每小时播送两次天气。

examples.sentence: A live broadcast can still be wrong if nobody checks the map.
examples.trans: 如果没人核对地图，直播仍可能是错的。

examples.sentence: To broadcast a rumour is to take a share of the harm.
examples.trans: 播送谣言就是分走一份伤害。

examples.sentence: A 24-hour broadcast of panic is a business hours of fear.
examples.trans: 二十四小时播送恐慌，是恐惧的营业时间。

examples.sentence: Whoever can broadcast without a right of reply already owns the room.
examples.trans: 能播送而对方没有回应权的人，已经拥有了这个房间。

abundant.usageZh: 形容词。常用搭配：abundant resources (丰富的资源)，abundant evidence (充足的证据)。

examples.sentence: The garden had abundant tomatoes in August.
examples.trans: 八月花园里有充足的番茄。

examples.sentence: Abundant rain filled the school pond overnight.
examples.trans: 充足的雨水一夜灌满了学校的池塘。

examples.sentence: We have abundant paper, so print the scripts for everyone.
examples.trans: 我们有充足的纸，所以给每个人打印剧本。

examples.sentence: Abundant data is not the same as abundant understanding.
examples.trans: 充足的数据并不等于充足的理解。

examples.sentence: An abundant harvest can still sit beside an empty wage.
examples.trans: 充足的收成仍可能挨着空的工资。

examples.sentence: Abundant content and scarce attention is the actual scarcity of the age.
examples.trans: 内容充足而注意力稀缺，才是这个时代真正的稀缺。

opportunity.usageZh: 可数名词。常用短语：seize/grab an opportunity (抓住机会)，a golden opportunity (绝佳机会)。

examples.sentence: The club is an opportunity to try the drums.
examples.trans: 社团是一个尝试打鼓的机会。

examples.sentence: A rainy day is an opportunity to finish the puzzle.
examples.trans: 雨天是完成拼图的机会。

examples.sentence: Don't miss the opportunity to ask one good question.
examples.trans: 不要错过问一个好问题的机会。

examples.sentence: Unpaid internships sold as opportunity are still unpaid hours.
examples.trans: 被当作机会售卖的无薪实习仍是无薪工时。

examples.sentence: Crisis is an opportunity only for the people who already have a spare room.
examples.trans: 危机只对已经有空房间的人来说是机会。

examples.sentence: Equal opportunity that ignores the bus timetable is a poster on a locked door.
examples.trans: 忽略公交时刻表的机会平等，是锁着的门上的海报。

with the development of.usageZh: 介词短语，后接名词或名词短语。用于引出原因或背景。中文：介词短语，后接名词。用于引出发展的原因或背景。

examples.sentence: With the development of phones, maps live in our pockets.
examples.trans: 随着手机的发展，地图住进了口袋。

examples.sentence: With the development of the new road, the shop got more visitors.
examples.trans: 随着新路的发展，店里客人多了。

examples.sentence: With the development of online classes, some students felt more tired.
examples.trans: 随着网课的发展，有些学生更累了。

examples.sentence: With the development of delivery apps, night streets got quieter kitchens.
examples.trans: 随着外卖应用的发展，夜里的街道有了更安静的厨房。

examples.sentence: With the development of ranking algorithms, outrage became a job.
examples.trans: 随着排序算法的发展，愤怒变成了一种工作。

examples.sentence: With the development of 'smart' cities, the right to be uncounted became rare.
examples.trans: 随着“智慧”城市的发展，不被计数的权利变得稀有。

as long as.usageZh: 连词短语，引导条件状语从句。中文：连词短语，引导条件状语从句，表示必要条件。

examples.sentence: You can play as long as you finish the vegetables.
examples.trans: 只要你吃完蔬菜，就可以玩。

examples.sentence: We will wait as long as the rain is light.
examples.trans: 只要雨不大，我们就等。

examples.sentence: As long as you tell the truth, we can fix the rest.
examples.trans: 只要你说实话，其余的我们能修。

examples.sentence: The offer stands as long as the stock lasts — a sentence designed to hurry you.
examples.trans: 优惠有效只要还有库存——这句话是为了催你。

examples.sentence: Rights exist as long as someone can afford the bus to claim them.
examples.trans: 权利存在，只要有人坐得起去主张它们的公交。

examples.sentence: Peace lasts as long as the minutes are public; secret minutes are a countdown.
examples.trans: 和平持续，只要会议记录是公开的；秘密记录是倒计时。

keen on.usageZh: 形容词短语，后接名词或动词-ing形式。中文：形容词短语，后接名词或动名词，表示对某事有浓厚兴趣。

examples.sentence: She is keen on drawing cats in the margin.
examples.trans: 她热衷于在页边画猫。

examples.sentence: He is keen on football but not on early mornings.
examples.trans: 他热衷足球，却不热衷早起。

examples.sentence: Are you keen on joining the coding club this term?
examples.trans: 你这学期热衷于加入编程社吗？

examples.sentence: Investors are keen on speed and less keen on the night-shift log.
examples.trans: 投资者热衷速度，却不那么热衷夜班记录。

examples.sentence: A board keen on disruption is often keen on someone else's sleep.
examples.trans: 热衷颠覆的董事会常常热衷于别人的睡眠。

examples.sentence: Governments keen on innovation still need to be keen on buses that arrive.
examples.trans: 热衷创新的政府仍需要热衷于会到达的公交。

at a ... price.usageZh: 介词短语，中间常加形容词（如low, high, reasonable）。中文：介词短语，'at'后接'a'加形容词再加'price'，表示商品的价格水平。

examples.sentence: She bought the book at a low price in the sale.
examples.trans: 她在打折时以低价买了这本书。

examples.sentence: Tickets at a student price sold out before noon.
examples.trans: 学生价的票中午前就卖完了。

examples.sentence: Fruit at a fair price still needs to be carried home.
examples.trans: 公平价格的水果仍需要被带回家。

examples.sentence: Convenience at a hidden price is just a delayed bill.
examples.trans: 隐藏价格的便利只是延迟的账单。

examples.sentence: Growth at a human price should appear on the same slide as the profit.
examples.trans: 以人为代价的增长应和利润出现在同一张幻灯片上。

examples.sentence: Safety at a ... price is how a company says it has already chosen the number it will pay for harm.
examples.trans: “以……的价格买安全”是公司在说它已选好愿为伤害付的数。

on most occasions.usageZh: 介词短语，作状语，常置于句首或句中。中文：介词短语，作状语，表示频率或一般情况。

examples.sentence: On most occasions she walks, not buses.
examples.trans: 在大多数情况下她走路，不坐公交。

examples.sentence: On most occasions the library is quieter than the hall.
examples.trans: 在大多数情况下图书馆比大厅更安静。

examples.sentence: On most occasions a kind question works better than a loud one.
examples.trans: 在大多数情况下，友善的问题比大声的问题更有效。

examples.sentence: On most occasions the delay is a staffing choice, not weather.
examples.trans: 在大多数情况下，延误是人员配置的选择，不是天气。

examples.sentence: On most occasions 'no comment' is a comment.
examples.trans: 在大多数情况下，“无可奉告”就是一种表态。

examples.sentence: On most occasions the exception in the contract is the actual contract.
examples.trans: 在大多数情况下，合同里的例外才是真正的合同。

fond of.usageZh: 形容词短语，后接名词、代词或动词-ing形式。中文：形容词短语，'be fond of'后接名词或动名词，表示喜爱。

examples.sentence: He is fond of warm bread after practice.
examples.trans: 他喜欢训练后的热面包。

examples.sentence: Grandma is fond of old songs on the radio.
examples.trans: 奶奶喜欢收音机里的老歌。

examples.sentence: I am fond of this park even when it rains.
examples.trans: 即使下雨，我仍喜欢这个公园。

examples.sentence: Voters may be fond of a slogan and still need a timetable.
examples.trans: 选民可能喜欢一句口号，却仍需要时间表。

examples.sentence: A paper fond of adjectives is usually short of verbs.
examples.trans: 喜欢形容词的论文通常缺少动词。

examples.sentence: A public fond of heroes will be slow to inspect a system.
examples.trans: 喜欢英雄的公众会很慢去检查一个系统。

in that case.usageZh: 介词短语，作状语，用于承接上文提到的情况。中文：介词短语，作状语，用于引出基于前述情况的结果或建议。

family.meaning: 在那种情况下，那样的话
在那种情况下，那样的话

examples.sentence: If it rains, in that case we will stay in the hall.
examples.trans: 如果下雨，那样的话我们就待在大厅。

examples.sentence: Lost your key? In that case call the office.
examples.trans: 钥匙丢了？那样的话给办公室打电话。

examples.sentence: If the shop is closed, in that case we cook rice at home.
examples.trans: 如果店关了，那样的话我们就在家煮米饭。

examples.sentence: If the number cannot be sourced, in that case cut it.
examples.trans: 如果数字找不到来源，那样的话就删掉它。

examples.sentence: If the night shift is unpaid, in that case the profit is a confession.
examples.trans: 如果夜班没有报酬，那样的话利润就是供词。

examples.sentence: If the minutes are secret, in that case the meeting was not public, whatever the poster said.
examples.trans: 如果记录是秘密的，那样的话会议就不是公开的，无论海报怎么写。

in advance.usageZh: 介词短语，作状语，常与动词如book, pay, reserve等连用。中文：介词短语，作状语，表示动作发生在预定时间之前。

examples.sentence: Please tell me in advance if you will be late.
examples.trans: 如果你会迟到，请提前告诉我。

examples.sentence: We packed snacks in advance for the long bus.
examples.trans: 我们为长途公交提前准备了零食。

examples.sentence: Book the room in advance during exam week.
examples.trans: 考试周期间请提前订房间。

examples.sentence: Warn the community in advance if the water will stop.
examples.trans: 如果要停水，请提前告知社区。

examples.sentence: Paying in advance for a conclusion is how research becomes advertising.
examples.trans: 为结论提前付钱，就是研究变成广告的方式。

examples.sentence: A hearing whose outcome is known in advance is a ceremony with microphones.
examples.trans: 结果被提前知道的听证是带麦克风的仪式。

log on to.usageZh: 动词短语，后接系统、网站或应用名称。'Log in to' 是常见变体。中文：动词短语，后接名词，表示通过输入信息进入数字系统。

examples.sentence: Log on to the class site to see the homework.
examples.trans: 登录班级网站查看作业。

examples.sentence: She cannot log on to the app without the school email.
examples.trans: 没有学校邮箱，她无法登录这个应用。

examples.sentence: Please log on to the map before you leave the station.
examples.trans: 离开车站前请登录地图。

examples.sentence: Workers log on to a system that logs them in return.
examples.trans: 工人登录一个反过来记录他们的系统。

examples.sentence: If you must log on to pay a tax, the tax has become a software licence.
examples.trans: 如果交税必须登录，税就变成了软件许可证。

examples.sentence: A right you can exercise only if you log on to a private platform is already rented.
examples.trans: 只有登录私人平台才能行使的权利，已经被租出去了。

as for.usageZh: 介词短语，用于引出要谈论的另一个话题或方面，后接名词、代词或动名词。中文：介词短语，用于转换或引出话题，后接名词性成分。

examples.sentence: As for me, I will take the earlier bus.
examples.trans: 至于我，我会坐更早的那班车。

examples.sentence: As for the cake, we will share it after practice.
examples.trans: 至于蛋糕，我们训练后分享。

examples.sentence: As for the rumour, wait for the teacher’s notice.
examples.trans: 至于谣言，等老师的通知。

examples.sentence: As for the missing number, it is not missing; it is unpublished.
examples.trans: 至于那个缺失的数字，它不是缺失，是未公布。

examples.sentence: As for the apology, colour is not a remedy.
examples.trans: 至于道歉，颜色不是救济。

examples.sentence: As for the public, they were invited to clap, not to amend.
examples.trans: 至于公众，他们被请来鼓掌，不是来修改。

gained attention.usageZh: 动词短语，通常为 'gain attention from sb.'。'Gain' 是及物动词，后接名词 'attention'。中文：动词短语，结构为“获得...的关注”。

examples.sentence: Her poster gained attention because of the bright bird.
examples.trans: 她的海报因为那只亮眼的鸟获得了关注。

examples.sentence: The lost-cat notice gained attention on the stairwell wall.
examples.trans: 寻猫启事在楼梯间墙上获得了关注。

examples.sentence: His science project gained attention after the volcano really smoked.
examples.trans: 火山真的冒烟后，他的科学项目获得了关注。

examples.sentence: The video gained attention, then the correction arrived too late.
examples.trans: 视频获得了关注，更正却来得太晚。

examples.sentence: A leak gained attention because the official channel had gone quiet.
examples.trans: 泄露获得了关注，因为官方渠道安静了。

examples.sentence: Suffering that has not gained attention is still suffering; virality is not a moral test.
examples.trans: 尚未获得关注的苦难仍是苦难；病毒式传播不是道德测验。

regard as.usageZh: 动词短语，结构为 'regard A as B'。'As' 是介词，后接名词或形容词。中文：动词短语，结构为“把A看作B”。

examples.sentence: I regard her as a kind leader in our group.
examples.trans: 我把她看作我们小组里友善的领导者。

examples.sentence: They regard the library as a quiet second home.
examples.trans: 他们把图书馆看作安静的第二个家。

examples.sentence: Don't regard a first mistake as a final grade.
examples.trans: 不要把第一次错误看作最终成绩。

examples.sentence: Courts regard a contract as more than a mood.
examples.trans: 法庭把合同看作不只是心情。

examples.sentence: Platforms regard users as inventory even when they say community.
examples.trans: 平台把用户看作库存，即使他们说社群。

examples.sentence: A state that can regard dissent as noise has already left argument for acoustics.
examples.trans: 能把异议看作噪音的国家，已经离开论证，走向声学。

make use of.usageZh: 动词短语，结构为 'make use of sth.'。'Of' 是介词，后接名词或名词短语。中文：动词短语，意为“利用某物”。

examples.sentence: Make use of the dictionary on your desk.
examples.trans: 利用桌上的词典。

examples.sentence: We make use of leftover paper for drafts.
examples.trans: 我们利用剩余的纸打草稿。

examples.sentence: Make use of the extra ten minutes to check names.
examples.trans: 利用多出来的十分钟核对名字。

examples.sentence: Hospitals make use of night staff as if they were a renewable resource.
examples.trans: 医院利用夜班员工，仿佛他们是可再生资源。

examples.sentence: To make use of a crisis for branding is to treat harm as a prop.
examples.trans: 利用危机做品牌，就是把伤害当道具。

examples.sentence: A city that can make use of volunteers instead of a budget has outsourced its duty.
examples.trans: 能用志愿者代替预算的城市，已经把责任外包了。

hot topic.usageZh: 名词短语。通常用作表语或宾语，如 'is a hot topic', 'discuss a hot topic'。中文：名词短语，常用作“是/成为一个热门话题”。

examples.sentence: Lunch queues became a hot topic in our class chat.
examples.trans: 午餐排队成了我们班级聊天里的热门话题。

examples.sentence: The school play is a hot topic this week.
examples.trans: 学校话剧是这周的热门话题。

examples.sentence: A hot topic can still be a thin one if nobody has facts.
examples.trans: 如果没人有事实，热门话题仍然可以很薄。

examples.sentence: A hot topic on a platform is often a temperature, not a finding.
examples.trans: 平台上的热门话题常常是温度，不是发现。

examples.sentence: Editors should ask who heated the hot topic, and with whose money.
examples.trans: 编辑应问是谁把热门话题加热的，用的是谁的钱。

examples.sentence: Governing by hot topic is how a week of clips replaces a year of maintenance.
examples.trans: 靠热门话题治理，就是用一周的片段替换一年的维护。

renowned teachers.usageZh: 名词短语。'Renowned' 是形容词，意为“著名的”，修饰名词 'teachers'。中文：名词短语，“著名的”修饰“教师”。

examples.sentence: Renowned teachers still write the date on the board.
examples.trans: 名师仍会把日期写在黑板上。

examples.sentence: The camp invited renowned teachers to sit with beginners.
examples.trans: 营地请来名师和初学者坐在一起。

examples.sentence: Renowned teachers cannot replace sleep, however famous the handout.
examples.trans: 无论讲义多有名，名师也替代不了睡眠。

examples.sentence: Online courses sell renowned teachers and deliver a recording.
examples.trans: 网课售卖名师，交付的是录像。

examples.sentence: A brand of renowned teachers can still rest on unpaid markers.
examples.trans: 名师品牌仍可能建立在无薪阅卷人上。

examples.sentence: If renowned teachers cannot change the timetable, renown is decoration.
examples.trans: 如果名师改不了时间表，名声就是装饰。

by themselves.usageZh: 介词短语，作方式状语。常位于句末，修饰动词。中文：介词短语，作状语，意为“独自地”。

examples.sentence: The younger kids walked home by themselves today.
examples.trans: 小孩子今天自己走回家。

examples.sentence: They walked to the corner shop by themselves after practice.
examples.trans: 训练后他们自己走到街角商店。

examples.sentence: Students can check answers by themselves before they ask.
examples.trans: 学生可以先自己核对答案，再提问。

examples.sentence: Patients cannot navigate the forms by themselves if the language is a maze.
examples.trans: 如果语言是迷宫，病人无法自己走完表格。

examples.sentence: Workers left to fix safety by themselves are being asked to donate risk.
examples.trans: 被留下来自己修安全的工人，是在被要求捐赠风险。

examples.sentence: A public told to thrive by themselves has been given a slogan instead of a bus.
examples.trans: 被要求自己繁荣的公众，得到的是口号而不是公交。

no matter where.usageZh: 让步状语从句引导词 'no matter where'，后接主语和谓语。中文：让步状语从句引导词“无论在哪里”，引导从句。

examples.sentence: No matter where you sit, you can still hear the story.
examples.trans: 无论你坐在哪里，仍能听见故事。

examples.sentence: No matter where we picnic, we pack the rubbish home.
examples.trans: 无论我们在哪里野餐，都把垃圾带回家。

examples.sentence: No matter where the trip goes, bring water.
examples.trans: 无论旅行去哪里，都要带水。

examples.sentence: No matter where the server sits, the duty to users does not move.
examples.trans: 无论服务器在哪里，对用户的责任不会搬家。

examples.sentence: No matter where a leak is published, the original file still has an owner.
examples.trans: 无论泄露发表在哪里，原始文件仍有主人。

examples.sentence: No matter where official speech travels, the queue at home remains the test.
examples.trans: 无论官方讲话走到哪里，家里的队列仍是测验。

are against.usageZh: 动词短语，'are' 是 be 动词，'against' 是介词，后接名词或动名词。结构为 'be against (doing) sth.'。中文：动词短语，意为“反对（做）某事”。

examples.sentence: Some parents are against extra homework on Friday.
examples.trans: 有些家长反对周五额外作业。

examples.sentence: They are against running in the wet hall.
examples.trans: 他们反对在潮湿的大厅里跑。

examples.sentence: I am not against games, but I am against games at midnight. The phrase 'are against' belongs in this context.
examples.trans: 我不反对游戏，但我反对午夜游戏。

examples.sentence: Unions are against a roster that deletes sick days.
examples.trans: 工会反对删掉病假的排班。

examples.sentence: If the minutes say nobody is against, check who was allowed to speak. The phrase 'are against' belongs in this context.
examples.trans: 如果记录说没有人反对，检查谁被允许说话。

examples.sentence: Citizens who are against a policy still belong in the room; exile is not a rebuttal.
examples.trans: 反对一项政策的公民仍属于这个房间；放逐不是反驳。

cut down the price.usageZh: 动词短语，'cut down' 意为“削减”，后接 'the price' 作宾语。也可说 'cut down on the price'。中文：动词短语，“降低”与“价格”搭配。

examples.sentence: The shop will cut down the price after the festival.
examples.trans: 节日后商店会降低价格。

examples.sentence: They cut down the price of fruit because it would spoil.
examples.trans: 他们降低水果价格，因为水果会坏。

examples.sentence: Can we cut down the price if we buy three books together?
examples.trans: 如果我们一起买三本书，能降低价格吗？

examples.sentence: Apps cut down the price of a ride by cutting down the driver's hour.
examples.trans: 应用降低车费，靠的是削减司机的小时。

examples.sentence: To cut down the price and hide the fee is not a discount; it is a trick.
examples.trans: 降低价格再藏起费用不是折扣，是把戏。

examples.sentence: Governments that cut down the price of a promise will pay it in a later budget.
examples.trans: 降低承诺价格的政府，会在之后的预算里支付。

win-win pattern.usageZh: 名词短语。'Win-win' 是复合形容词，修饰名词 'pattern'。中文：名词短语，“双赢的”修饰“模式”。

examples.sentence: Sharing umbrellas was a win-win pattern in the rain.
examples.trans: 下雨时共用伞是一种双赢模式。

examples.sentence: The club found a win-win pattern: older students coach, younger ones bring snacks.
examples.trans: 社团找到双赢模式：学长教练，学弟带零食。

examples.sentence: A win-win pattern still needs someone to wash the cups.
examples.trans: 双赢模式仍需要有人洗杯子。

examples.sentence: A contract called a win-win pattern may still have a silent third party.
examples.trans: 被称为双赢模式的合同仍可能有沉默的第三方。

examples.sentence: Platforms sell a win-win pattern while the night shift pays the round.
examples.trans: 平台售卖双赢模式，夜班却付这一轮的账。

examples.sentence: A public win-win pattern that cannot name a loser is usually hiding one.
examples.trans: 叫不出输家的公共双赢模式，通常是在藏一个输家。

grammar.title: 一般现在时被动语态及相关：am/is/are + 过去分词 / by

grammar.usage:
当承受者比执行者更重要时用被动：S + am/is/are + 过去分词 (+ by 执行者)。
否定：am/is/are not + V-ed；疑问：Am/Is/Are + S + V-ed。
初中：by 可省略；不规则动词用过去分词（written, made）。
高中：含情态的被动 must be done；双宾语改为 to/for；get-passive 偏口语。不及物动词没有被动。It is said that / sb is said to do 是书面常见转换。
forms: It is said that ... / sb is said to ...
notes: 不要漏 be。
过去分词不是过去式。
by 后接执行者。
不及物动词无被动。
get done 较口语。

examples.cn: 许多国家都说英语。

examples.en: The classroom is cleaned every morning.
examples.cn: 教室每天早上打扫。

examples.en: We are influenced by our families from an early age.

grammar.key: Present Perfect Tense / 现在完成时
grammar.title: 现在完成时（经历/持续）及 since / for / already / yet / have been able to
grammar.titleEn: Present perfect for life experience and unfinished time
grammar.usage:
现在完成时：have/has + 过去分词，把过去发生的事与现在联系起来。
用法一：到现在为止的经历（ever / never / before）。
用法二：从过去持续到现在（since + 点时间 / for + 一段时间）。
否定：have/has not；疑问：Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词。
初中：since 与 for 不要混；不规则动词用过去分词，不是过去式。
高中：现在完成进行时 have been doing 强调不间断；短暂动词（go/buy）在肯定句中不宜与 for 连用表示持续；对比一般过去时（有明确过去时间状语 yesterday/in 2019 时用过去时）。already 多用于肯定，yet 多用于否定/疑问。
forms: S + have/has + V-ed + since + 时间点
S + have/has + V-ed + for + 时段
have been doing（完成进行） / have been able to
notes: since 接时间点，for 接一段时间。
有明确过去时间（yesterday）时用一般过去时，不用现在完成时。
第三人称单数用 has，不是 have。
过去分词不要写成过去式（has wrote → has written）。
already 通常不与否定连用，否定用 yet。

examples.en: I have finished my homework.
examples.cn: 我已经做完作业了。

examples.en: She has lived here since 2019.
examples.cn: 她从2019年起就住在这里。

grammar.key: Conditional Sentences (Type 1) / 条件句（第一类）
grammar.title: 第一类条件句（If + 现在，主句 will/情态/祈使）及 unless / as long as
grammar.titleEn: First Conditional and related real conditions
grammar.usage:
第一类条件句谈论真实、将来很可能发生的情况。
结构：If + 一般现在时, 主句用 will / can / must / 祈使句。
否定：If it doesn't rain, we will go out. 或 Unless it rains, we will go out.
疑问：What will you do if you miss the bus?
初中：if 从句不用 will；if 在句首时用逗号。
高中拓展：unless = if not；as long as / provided that 表示只要；even if 表示即使（让步，不是纯条件）；will 偶尔出现在 if 从句中表示“愿意”（If you will wait a moment）。不要把 if 从句的 will 当成将来时标记。
forms: If + S + 现在时, S + will/can/must + V
If + S + 现在时, 祈使句
Unless + S + 现在时, S + will + V  (= If ... not)
As long as / Provided that + 现在时, 主句将来
notes: if 从句用一般现在时，不用 will（愿意义除外）。
unless 已经含否定，不要再加 not。
主句可以是祈使句或情态动词，不一定是 will。
even if 是让步，不等于 if。
if 在句中时，通常不用逗号。

grammar.title: 比较结构 more ... than / -er than / as ... as
grammar.usage:
两者比较：形容词/副词比较级 + than。
单音节多加 -er，多音节用 more；good→better, bad→worse。
同级：as + 原级 + as；否定 not as/so ... as。
the more ... the more 是比例共变，不要和 more and more（越来越）混用。
高中：no more than / not more than；superior to 不再加 than。
notes: 不要 more taller。
than 后可用代词。
as ... as 用原级。
fewer + 可数，less + 不可数。
more and more ≠ the more..., the more...

grammar.title: 不定式表目的：to / in order to / so as to 及 so that

to do 可表目的：She trains to become a champion.
in order to 更正式；so as to 多用于书面，否定 so as not to。

for + 名词 也可表目的：for safety。不要 for doing 表目的（除少数固定）。
notes: to 后原形。
in order to 可放句首。
so as to 很少放句首。
否定用 so as not to / in order not to。
for doing 一般不表目的。

grammar.key: Present Perfect Tense / 现在完成时
grammar.title: 现在完成时（经历/持续）及 since / for / already / yet / have been able to
grammar.titleEn: Present perfect for life experience and unfinished time
grammar.usage:
现在完成时：have/has + 过去分词，把过去发生的事与现在联系起来。
用法一：到现在为止的经历（ever / never / before）。
用法二：从过去持续到现在（since + 点时间 / for + 一段时间）。
否定：have/has not；疑问：Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词。
初中：since 与 for 不要混；不规则动词用过去分词，不是过去式。
高中：现在完成进行时 have been doing 强调不间断；短暂动词（go/buy）在肯定句中不宜与 for 连用表示持续；对比一般过去时（有明确过去时间状语 yesterday/in 2019 时用过去时）。already 多用于肯定，yet 多用于否定/疑问。
forms: S + have/has + V-ed + since + 时间点
S + have/has + V-ed + for + 时段
have been doing（完成进行） / have been able to
notes: since 接时间点，for 接一段时间。
有明确过去时间（yesterday）时用一般过去时，不用现在完成时。
第三人称单数用 has，不是 have。
过去分词不要写成过去式（has wrote → has written）。
already 通常不与否定连用，否定用 yet。

examples.en: I have finished my homework.
examples.cn: 我已经做完作业了。

examples.en: She has lived here since 2019.
examples.cn: 她从2019年起就住在这里。

examples.en: We have been influenced by our families since birth.
examples.cn: 自出生以来，我们就一直受到家庭的影响。

examples.en: He has already reached out to three mentors this term.
examples.cn: 这学期他已经联系了三位导师。

examples.en: The team has not yet pinned down the exact cause of the delay.
examples.cn: 团队尚未确定延误的确切原因。

examples.en: Public debate has become more fragmented over the past decade.
examples.cn: 过去十年里，公共讨论变得更加碎片化。

grammar.title: 定语从句 which/that（物）及介词 + which / 非限制性 which
grammar.usage:
指物用 which/that。限制性从句中 that 与 which 常可换；非限制性只能 which，且有逗号。
介词 + which：the platform on which we broadcast。
which 还可指代整个主句：He missed the jump, which shocked us。
高中：the way in which = how；as 也可引导非限制性。
notes: 人不用 which。
主谓与先行词一致。
不要重复 he/she。
介词后不用 that。
非限制性不用 that。

examples.cn: 坐我旁边的女孩是露西。

examples.en: I have a friend who always lends a hand.

examples.en: Athletes who insist on safety are not less passionate.
examples.cn: 坚持安全的运动员并不缺少热情。

grammar.title: 让步状语从句 even though / even if / though
grammar.usage:
even though 引导让步，事实意味强：Even though it rained, we played.
even if 更偏假设：Even if it rains, we will play.
though / although 不与 but 连用，可与 yet/still 连用。
高中：despite / in spite of + 名词；while 也可表让步；adj. + as + S + V 倒装让步。
notes: 不要 although ... but。
even though 后是从句不是名词。
despite 后不加 that 从句（要用 the fact that）。
even if ≠ if。
though 可放句末作副词。
